systems.system: Health Resources and Services Availability Monitoring System (HeRAMS)
systems.tiers: health service delivery units, reported at state level across 18 states and Abyei

note: Passages only: the interpretation guide says the infographics cover the availability of facility-based epidemiological reporting and HMIS, defined by completeness, timeliness and accuracy of reports, but the passages carry none of the figures. HeRAMS itself monitors service and resource availability, not patients treated.
